FDA posts the leucovorin calcium shortage

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 150 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA posted the leucovorin calcium shortage on 2012-01-01 and it has remained on the list for 178 months as of 2026-10-21.
A registered plant on our labels, Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343), received an OAI classification on 2011-08-04, 150 days before the shortage posting.
That same plant had earlier OAI inspections on 2010-01-19 (712 days before posting) and 2011-06-17 (198 days before posting), plus a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12 (629 days before posting).
Another labeled plant, West-Ward Columbus Inc. (FEI 1510690), received a Warning Letter on 2009-03-30 (1007 days before posting) and a VAI inspection on 2011-01-20 (346 days before posting).
Current inventory across our three sites provides 20 to 24 days on hand at present usage rates.
The rule-selected purchase option is American Health Packaging, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-87c3e7.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%calcium%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%calcium%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-1ce85b.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('33663425-4731-4977-9127-9e59b6b91497', 'cc52077f-5663-4f79-a273-0aecf655e038', '3cbf6bf7-2415-4435-b3df-41855514a05d', 'c4c65e48-85f8-4dcf-6281-06e40959cc79', '9d0e5356-ff39-4a8e-944c-e808a21ef4b2', '13d7cfc9-ff7a-437e-8c21-d9709ac07d48') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-fa78bc.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%leucovorin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-7f6560.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%leucovorin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-53094a.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%leucovorin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-334351.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3017573557', '3002808250', '1510690', '1021343') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-895db4.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3017573557', '3002808250', '1510690', '1021343') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-16a4b3.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3017573557', '3002808250', '1510690', '1021343') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('amneal', 'cerbios', 'west ward columbus', 'sagent pharms', 'hospira', 'hikma farmaceutica')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-aaed14.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('amneal', 'cerbios', 'west ward columbus', 'sagent pharms', 'hospira', 'hikma farmaceutica', 'hikma', 'b braun medical', 'henry schein', 'sagent') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%leucovorin%' ORDER BY initiation_date
